Nick's Voxel Blog: Implementing Dual Contouring
If you've implemented Marching Cubes then the corners variable should look familiar. Each of the first 8 bits represents a corner of the node's bounding box. If the density value at the corner position is negative the corner is inside the volume, otherwise the corner is outside the volume.
